lintIssues.message: Program must start with a standalone % line.
Program must end with a standalone % line.
Axis motion before any work offset (G54-G59/G154) — select a work coordinate system first.
Axis motion before G90/G91 — set absolute or incremental distance mode first.
Axis motion before any unit mode (G20/G21) — select inch or metric units first.
Axis motion before any feed mode (G93/G94/G95) — select inverse-time, per-minute, or per-rev feed mode first.
Axis motion before any plane mode (G17/G18/G19) — select XY/XZ/YZ plane first.
Canned cycle (G73/G76/G81-G83/G85-G89) while spindle is off — start spindle before the cycle.
Peck canned cycle (G73/G83) without Q — set peck depth Q explicitly.
Program ends with a canned cycle still active — cancel with G80 before end.

warnings: Cycle G83 missing Q peck value at block 1.
Cycle G83 has invalid Q value at block 1.
